title: Operator Qualification & Vehicle/Machine/Equipment Integration
objective: Resolve bounded operator-qualification consumption of completed KFR familiarity/transfer evidence for vehicle, machine and equipment domains without allowing familiarity or advisory transfer state to substitute for canonical qualification, progression, permission, ownership, custody, asset or action-authority state.

resolved_contract.qualification_evidence_rule: Only explicit visible canonical-owner qualification evidence resolves qualified or unqualified. Missing and explicit-unknown remain unknown, incompatible remains incompatible, and conflicting qualified/unqualified evidence remains unresolved unknown for canonical owner resolution.
resolved_contract.transfer_boundary: KFR-03 familiarity and KFR-04 advisory transfer/confidence are explanatory only and never grant or upgrade qualification.
resolved_contract.station_authority_rule: Visible active VehicleStationGrant authority is projected separately from qualification; KFR-05 creates and mutates no station grant.
resolved_contract.vehicle_platform_rule: MIB-14 vehicle/platform/base/mecha/ship operational definitions remain read-only canonical integration inputs and do not themselves qualify an operator.
resolved_contract.equipment_asset_rule: D17 remains sole live Asset/equipment identity, ownership, custody and state authority; KFR-05 performs no Asset mutation.
resolved_contract.authority_rule: A qualified projection is evidence only and grants no permission, executable action authority, ownership, custody, proficiency/certification mutation or canonical owner mutation.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized qualification evidence, KFR context, station grants and target references are filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is not exposed.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-05 persistence or duplicate qualification ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Accessible nonvisual qualification, station-authority, advisory-context and owner-boundary explanations implemented.
